prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1233; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn in League City, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had stopped at the intersection and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic before I started to move. The impact threw me against the steering wheel and the door, and I felt immediate pain in my left wrist. I have given the same description of what happened every time I have spoken with anyone about the collision, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this claim for the injury to my wrist, which was diagnosed as a fracture, along with the damage to my vehicle.
